hints.title: Minimal Cost Selection
hints.text: To minimize money spent, determine the two smallest prices available.

hints.title: Order by Price
hints.text: Sorting the array brings the lowest prices to the front directly.

hints.title: Budget Verification
hints.text: Calculate the sum of the first two elements and verify if it exceeds your budget.

hints.title: Greedy Solution
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def buyChoco(self, prices: list[int], money: int) -> int:
        prices.sort()
        cost = prices[0] + prices[1]
        return money - cost if cost <= money else money
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs takes quadratic time while finding the two smallest takes linearithmic or linear time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place sort takes constant extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Selects the two smallest prices and checks the budget condition cleanly.
